cases.input: Rank six PASS candidates with complete 0–100 criterion scores, confirmed weights summing to one and current prices, then identify quality, value and bargain winners.
requiredBehaviors: run hard requirement gates before any winner calculation
calculate utility only from confirmed weights and keep evidence coverage separate
allow the same candidate to hold multiple winner labels
apply the bargain quality floor plus price and reliability evidence gates
forbiddenBehaviors: allow a FAIL candidate to win because of price
multiply utility by an invented confidence percentage

cases.input: The apparent top product has an unknown must-have and a missing high-weight score, while two fully evidenced alternatives are close and the result changes with plausible weighting.
requiredBehaviors: keep the uncertain candidate conditional and prevent an unconditional winner label
leave the missing high-weight criterion un-imputed
reduce ranking confidence and expose sensitivity to weighting
treat a configured near tie as low confidence even when tested weights do not reverse the winner
forbiddenBehaviors: fill missing evidence with a midpoint score
claim a stable unique winner despite material sensitivity
report high ranking confidence for a configured near tie

cases.input: A draft ranking gives a product with a failed size requirement the highest score, uses unconfirmed weights, and labels the cheapest option a bargain despite poor reliability evidence.
requiredBehaviors: reject the ranking because hard gates and confirmed weights are violated
recompute bargain eligibility only after quality floor evidence and reliability gates
forbiddenBehaviors: let aggregate score override a hard requirement failure
declare the cheapest candidate bargain by price alone
